text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I've finished bringing in
the hand towels that were hanging out to
dry.
choice_data_list: Thank you, those go inside the kit...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day before the summer training camp.
We arrived at the camp facility ahead of
the other horsegirls to help with
preparations.

text_block_list.name: Camp Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're a lifesaver!
To think you came out to help us again this
year.
choice_data_list: No trouble at all, I'm doing it pu...

text_block_list.name: Camp Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
That's what makes it so appreciated!
And to think your trainee even came all the
way out here to help...
We're truly grateful for your time.
choice_data_list: When I told her about it, she offe...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah—yes.
It isn't something I normally get to do—
and I just wanted to be of help to everyone
participating.

text_block_list.name: Camp Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! Truly worthy of being your trainee,
Trainer.
We're counting on you both today.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Alright,
that's the last cover fitted...
Trainer, this pillow is the final one.
choice_data_list: Great work, that's a huge help.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gazed at the mountain of pillows stacked
neatly inside the closet.
It really hit home just how many horsegirls
would be attending the camp.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Many of my classmates will be joining the
camp as well.
Starting tomorrow—
it's bound to be quite lively.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However... right now,
nobody else is here.
Only her gentle voice echoes softly...
while outside the window,
the trees sway peacefully in the breeze.
choice_data_list: It's nice having this quiet, empty...
It's nice having this quiet, empty...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Yes.
The feel of the tatami mats,
the soft sunlight—it's so calming.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
In previous years—
did you help out all by yourself, Trainer?
With this much work,
it must have taken quite a long time.
choice_data_list: I spent the entire day working alo...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Oh goodness...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
You volunteered to help with all this on
your own initiative, right?
Um... why do you go so far?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be sure,
this preparation is beyond the scope of my
official duties.
Even so...
I simply want to do whatever I can.
choice_data_list: Because I want this to be the best...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During the camp,
the training regimens are bound to be
grueling.
That's all the more reason why I want the
horsegirls to be as comfortable as
possible.
choice_data_list: And that includes you too, of cour...
And that includes you too, of cour...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
............Yes.
—Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list: —Bouquet?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I was just... remembering.
When the two of us went to the botanical
garden—and waited together.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That time we shared...
felt so gentle and comforting.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Well—
we've finished preparing the pillows,
so what should we help with nex—

text_block_list.name: Training Camp Staff
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Bouquet,
thank you for your hard work.
Thanks to you,
all the preparations are complete!
choice_data_list: ! —Everything went so quickly this...

text_block_list.name: Training Camp Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was all thanks to Bouquet lending
a hand.
Really, thank you so very much.

text_block_list.name: Training Camp Staff
text_block_list.text:
As a token of our gratitude,
please let us treat you to dinner.
We'll call for you once it's ready.
choice_data_list: If you'd like, we can help out?

text_block_list.name: Training Camp Staff
text_block_list.text:
No, no,
you two have a busy schedule starting
tomorrow.
Please just take it easy for the rest of
the day. See you later!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list: ...Looks like we've got some time ...
...Looks like we've got some time ...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
It seems so.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
In that case...
would you like to take a walk outside?
The sun is setting soon,
and it should be cooling down...
choice_data_list: Sounds great, let's do that.
Sounds great, let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
while waiting for dinner to be ready,
I decided to take a stroll along the nearby
beach with her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
What a beautiful sunset.
It reflects off the waves...
sparkling so brightly.
choice_data_list: Yeah. It's really soothing.
Yeah. It's really soothing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A gentle sea breeze enveloped the two of
us.
The sunset illuminated the golden sea as
the waves ebbed and flowed.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...It feels like lately, wherever we go,
I'm always waiting with you, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Thanks for keeping me company toda...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes—I actually love this time we spend
waiting.
It's such a gentle... and warm time.
choice_data_list: It feels really comfortable to me,...
It feels really comfortable to me,...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It might be the same feeling as when growing
flowers.
Even though you never quite know when they
will bloom—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
While you wait, you tend to them,
care for them...
and imagining the moment they blossom is so
wonderful. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...I feel like I'll be able to share that
joy with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If...
if the two of us keep waiting for the same
flower together—
then when it finally blooms,
I can share that joy with you just the
same.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure—not just flowers,
but even the far-off future as well.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I think about that...
it fills my heart with warmth.
choice_data_list: Bouquet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then,
a sudden gust of sea breeze blew past...
and a little further ahead,
I saw sand dancing in the air. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something in the sand caught the sunset and
glittered brightly.
choice_data_list: Hm... What's that—?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Drawing closer, a small pink object
peeked out from the sand,
shining under the setting sun.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
This is... a seashell, isn't it?
It looks like a cherry blossom petal...
How lovely.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If the wind hadn't blown—
would it have remained buried in the sand
forever, I wonder?
choice_data_list: Yeah... It might never have been f...
Yeah... It might never have been f...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Then...
this little one must have—
finally bloomed just now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A single petal nestled in the sand.
The crimson sky and golden sea.
And—Curren Bouquetd'or's gentle smile.
choice_data_list: ...It's beautiful.
...It's beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Hehe,
somehow...
it makes me want to see even more.
The future that will blossom...
far down the road.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Right now,
I don't even know what shape it will take.
And it will take a lot of time, but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The flowers I'll see with you...
are sure to be beautiful.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, absolutely.
...Yeah, absolutely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And if such a future awaits—
showing her that blooming moment is none
other than my duty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I picked up the seashell glittering in the
sand—
and held it straight out to her.
choice_data_list: I promise you, Bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?
choice_data_list: With you—I'll make sure our future...
With you—I'll make sure our future...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ......Yes. Let us wait together.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Until the moment it blooms—
just the two of us.
